method: Static IDA pseudocode/disassembly and original-byte comparison; source review, JSON/AST/lexical checks only. Never run game functions, the generator, compiler, tests, benchmarks, GUI or CI in this source-only batch.

native_evidence.finding: Exact five-cell group with horizontal run-three anchor and vertical endpoint distance two gives L. Native rows run bottom-up; both inequalities accept every fitting placement of all four existing L masks. Solver same-color border exclusion remains conservative.

Group metadata is reset for each removed group; impl+601622 maps L to group flag 0x40. Current attack color dispatches once per group. Native dispatch 525190 takes a separate path and is excluded by the new capture.

For each attack-color group, iterate six active==1 unbound members and create an entry for each matching current main/sub/third attribute. Heart and auxiliary effects also allocate queue entries; no universal total capacity bound is claimed.

Native pool capacity 256; allocates while count<=255. Entry flags at +44 encode sub as 2, third as 0x10000. Incoming group0x40 and effective awakening60>=1 set entry0x40, independent of positive damage. Slot at entry+52.

At each consumer frame cache current effective L count for active==1 members with latent48. Completed L entries add the provider count, deduplicating same-color main/sub/third within that group; separate L groups accumulate. v231 is animation membership, not a suppression of subsequent L groups.

Subtract accumulated credit from signed10 duration impl+739980; clamp to zero, preserve high0xF800, clear fresh0x400, and call 1005f6d88(game,1) on clear. Do not pre-credit restored assist awakenings or infer relative healing/damage ordering.

Positive assist void suppresses active assist unless effective awakening148 protects it. Source assist +1458 remains; protected member+472 low byte172 indicates retained equipment. Clearing active +1438 alone never proves consumption. Real restore can change derived HP/skill values.
Ordinary duration ticks can also restore equipment at zero. A next-stable sample cannot attribute a duration delta to L alone. No action permission relies on calling or predicting this routine.

source_behavior.capture_members: current-active-card, source/active-assist, protected-assist-state, temporary-form, effective-L, latent48, distinct-colors
source_behavior.rules: active==1; bound/awoken-bind/awakening-disabled/latent-disabled/no-latent/no-L cannot contribute; unsupported grants and variants stay unknown
source_behavior.capture_consistency: catalog pointer/count, entry identity, protected keys, interpreted automation/evidence, phase/wave/moves/drag
source_behavior.goals: retain every existing goal and heart rule; add minimal per-color L allocations predicted to cover the full current duration
source_behavior.preflight: distinct same-color exact-shape inventory and necessary T/L separators in every shared spinner phase
source_behavior.replay: selected candidate goals, independent final replay and release evaluation
source_behavior.execution: fresh pre-input evidence plus final native recheck after coordinate conversion; cleanup release remains available
source_behavior.outcome: require observed next stable duration zero; residual/reapply/unavailable stops without retry

written_regressions: Native effective L+, distinct attributes/overrides, multiple providers, disabled/unknown sources, retained equipment, guard isolation, read-only capture, consistency races and post-coordinate input boundary.
Planner sufficient/residual/multi-color/multi-group allocations, existing L reuse, six-goal limit, base/heart retention, spinner inventory and twelve-candidate bound.

Solver nine versus ten orbs for same-color T/L, independent coordinate witnesses, all four L orientations at board corners, multi-L first-wave counts, insufficient separators and shared spinner phases.

Session fresh versus diagnostic evidence, second candidate replay, shared deadline bookkeeping, cancellation before and during owned input, stable-zero outcome versus residual/reapply/unavailable, required skills, delayed and retained profile binding, lifecycle and multiplayer isolation.
Profile/config strict Boolean defaults, Uryu opt-in, exact source/retained/consumed separation, export/import, GUI acknowledgement and actual disk-save rollback/selected-plan coherence.
pending: Compile, execute all written and existing regressions, GUI, generated-header consistency and package only on a new explicit build/test request.
Establish a complete native queue capacity/support bound across cascades and auxiliary effects before treating predicted L credit as guaranteed.
Verify device post-void source identity, provider counts, multiple L/color recovery and actual status removal or enemy reapply.
Measure iPhone action-capture/guard cost and long-route frame pacing; no new performance result yet.
Implement enemy action branches, effective shields, healing bounds and restore ordering before L+heart-four defensive stall or delaying required rescue.

static_review.limits: No compilation, case execution, solver run, native timing, device recovery, queue-capacity, survival or performance result.
